name: Valley Surface Extraction via Constrained Gradient Descent
definition: A method to extract valley surfaces in complex scalar fields by identifying branching locations (partial umbilics) and connecting them using constrained gradient-based surface integration, specifically handling non-manifold regions where standard surface growing fails.
summary: Valley Surface Extraction via Constrained Gradient Descent extracts maximal convexity ridges in complex scalar fields by using constrained gradient descent in non-manifold regions where standard methods fail.
